verses.gurmukhi: ੬ : ਮੀਣਾ- ਨਕਟ ਪੰਥ ਨਰਕ ਲਿਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 6 : meenaa- nakaT pa(n)th narak lijaa(n)dhaa hai

en.bdb: The way of dissembler leads to hell-

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਧਿਕੁ ਨਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: badhik naadh sunaikai jiau mirag vinaahai|

en.bdb: As a hunter inveigles the deer with music and entraps it;

verses.gurmukhi: ਝੀਵਰੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਮਛੀ ਫਾਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: jheevar ku(n)ddee maas lai jiau machhee faahai|

en.bdb: As the fisherman putting meat on hook catches hold of the fish;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੈ ਮੁਹੁ ਖਿੜਾਇ ਭਵਰੈ ਵੇਸਾਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaval dhikhaalai muh khiRai bhavarai vesaahai|

en.bdb: As the lotus showing its blossommed face beguiles the black-bee;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਨੋ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਜਿਉ ਦਾਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: dheepak jot pata(n)g no dhurajan jiau dhaahai|

en.bdb: As the flame of lamp burns moth like an enemy;
As the paper-model of a female elephant makes the male counterpart erotomaniac;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਨਕਟ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਣਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: tiau nakaT pa(n)th hai meeniaa mil narak nibaahai ||6||

en.bdb: Similarly the way of brazen-faced dissemblers leads towards hell.
